title: Nepherites II
summary: King listed in CFAH-11 Table 1 (Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-11 (Table 1, "Proposed Dynasty 20 Rulers and Reigns"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Rgn: 4 mo.; BC Dates: 379). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-11: Dynasties 20 and 21," OSF preprint v1.3 (17 Nov 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/KSAZ9, file CFAH-11_v1.3.pdf, Table 1 "Proposed Dynasty 20 Rulers and Reigns", p. 22
reign.note: Row "Nepherites II (D29)" of Table 1 (Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30)).

dynasty: Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30)
